facts.guide_requirement: The mean primary metric across executions must favor the original against every Top10 and strong baseline.
facts.interpretation: A favorable descriptive mean is necessary but not sufficient.

facts.guide_requirement: At least three distinct Table4 tests reject equal performance for each contrast; Holm p<0.05. MCS uses its declared protocol level, typically0.10. The difference must exceed practical delta.
facts.interpretation: The literal null is equal performance. Requiring three nulls theta<=delta is an additional project choice, not a universal wording of the guide.

facts.guide_requirement: At least one of the three procedures must be global or control multiple comparisons.
facts.interpretation: Global relevance does not by itself assign a candidate-vs-rival directional p-value to every rival.

facts.guide_requirement: Absolute Cliff delta>=0.147 or Cohen d>=0.2 when applicable; lower95% difference confidence bound>0, ideally>practical delta.
facts.interpretation: Cliff delta is an effect-size symbol distinct from the project practical-margin delta.

facts.guide_requirement: Better mean in at least2of3additional datasets and no significantly worse result against any family member in any additional dataset.
facts.interpretation: The additional datasets must independently satisfy the selection/design requirements; retrospective calendars cannot restore prospectivity.

facts.guide_requirement: Beat trivial baseline; train-validation gap below margin; acceptable calibration/residuals and validation-test consistency.
facts.interpretation: Required comparisons and tolerances need their own units, partitions and justification.

facts.guide_requirement: Main conclusion robust to alternative parametric/nonparametric testing, relevant variance correction, secondary metric and reasonable seed subset.
facts.interpretation: Applicability of Nadeau-Bengio depends on resampling repeated partitions; it is not automatically appropriate for a crossed seed/calendar functional.

facts.guide_requirement: Original vs allTop10andstrongbaselines; Holm across entire declared family; no outcome-based exclusions. Secondary additional-dataset,ablation,subgroup andhorizon families are separately declared.
facts.interpretation: Do not reduce multiplicity post-result or assume one universal252-component family if the protocol declares justified separate families.

facts.guide_requirement: Power>=0.90 per contrast; report joint power; pilot>=5seeds; final>=10or more if power requires.
facts.interpretation: The guide does not impose joint power>=0.90. Increasing seeds alone does not repair a missing temporal information component.

facts.guide_requirement: Strict pairing, sealed final test and preselected hyperparameters; check normality,stationarity,independence,nesting; correct independence unit; rawandadjustedp andcomparisoncounts.
facts.interpretation: Numerically equal seed labels do not establish independent paired units or remove date dependence.

facts.guide_requirement: Declare seed/fold/series/block/case/dataset unit; aggregate correlated observations at independent unit; mixed-effects example includes unit and seed effects.
facts.interpretation: Date-only inference on a fixed cohort cannot be relabeled as unconditional random-seed inference.
This checklist defines the15%hypothesis/adequacycomponent; it contains methodological requirements that cannot be replaced by code existence.

method_admissibility.primary_mean_individual_RMSE_status: Nonlinear crossed-seed extension needs explicit derivation and validation; conventional temporal MCS on mean squared losses changes the estimand.
method_admissibility.cannot_claim: An excluded rival automatically has a directional practical-margin p-value against the candidate.

method_admissibility.primary_mean_individual_RMSE_status: A random-seed nonlinear functional requires additional uncertainty treatment/derivation. Per-date mean MSE tests are not identical to mean individual RMSE tests.
method_admissibility.cannot_claim: Forecast horizon1 removes sigma7overlap or allserialdependence.

method_admissibility.primary_mean_individual_RMSE_status: Does not automatically test the same unconditional cross-seed functional. Any extension needs explicit justification.
Cannot be a generic third test for heterogeneous neural models merely because parameter counts differ.
One correlated daily calendar is not automatically a collection of independent datasets/origins.
Can recompute the full functional; finiteS/highdimension and degeneracy remain empirical/theoretical issues.
Separatecross-datasetrequirement, not a substitute for within-panel seed/date inference.
method_admissibility.cannot_claim: Four convenient correlated historical panels establish broad independent confirmation.
